{{Infobox auto}}

'''Honied French toast''' is the meal of [[Honey|honey]]. It heals {{Value|Honied French Toast|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Speed}} {{Value|Honied French Toast|level|effect=Speed}} for {{Value|Honied French Toast|duration|effect=Speed}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/honied_french_toast.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A honey bottle, an egg, sugar, estus ash and bread (or naan). Picking up a honey bottle unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Honied French Toast|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Honied French Toast|heals}} and gives Speed {{Value|Honied French Toast|level|effect=Speed}} (+40% speed) for {{Value|Honied French Toast|duration|effect=Speed|format=clock}}.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_16.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
